name: soft-weak-empty
text:
SOFT ?= "first"
SOFT ?= "second"
WEAK ??= "first"
WEAK ??= "second"
EMPTY = ""
EMPTY ?= "ignored"

name: spaces
text:
A = "middle"
A += "right"
A =+ "left"
B = "middle"
B .= "right"
B =. "left"

name: operation-order
text:
ORDER = "one two"
ORDER:remove = "two"
ORDER:prepend = "zero "
ORDER:append = " two three"

name: expansion
text:
BASE = "old"
LAZY = "${BASE}"
NOW := "${BASE}"
BASE = "new"
UNKNOWN := "${NOT_YET}"
NOT_YET = "later"
VALUE = "${@str(6 * 7)}"
